title: Smart Data Models - Pen schema
description: Fenced area in a building or department or outside housing a group of animals. Animals in a pen can move and interact freely. Pens are often not completely separated from each other (half walls, iron bars, fences), making it possible that animals from neighbouring pens can see or touch each other.

type.description: NGSI Entity Type. It has to be Pen

additionalInfo.description: Property. List of all the raw values sent by the sensor or platform with any extra properties not included in the main structure, e.g. {'name': 'temperature', 'value': 32}

arrivalTimestamp.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Date and time of the arrival of animals to the pen

avgGrowth.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. The average growth in weight of the animals in this pen. Units:'kilograms' (UN/CEFACT KGM)

avgWeight.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. The average weight of the animals in this pen. Units:'kilograms' (UN/CEFACT KGM)

anyOf.description: Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Identifier format of any NGSI entity

buildingId.description: Relationship. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. Unique identifier of the Building the item is located in

co2.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. The CO2 concentration in the pen

anyOf.description: Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Identifier format of any NGSI entity

companyId.description: Relationship. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. Unique identifier of a company

anyOf.description: Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Identifier format of any NGSI entity

compartmentId.description: Relationship. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. Unique identifier of the Compartment the pen is located in

deadAnimalsSinceDateOfArrival.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Number of dead animals since the date of arrival

anyOf.description: Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Identifier format of any NGSI entity

farmId.description: Relationship. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. Unique identifier of the Farm the pen is located in

feedConsumption.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. The total amount of food eaten from the feeding station(s) in the pen. Units:'kilograms' (UN/CEFACT KGM)

humidity.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Amount of water vapour in the atmosphere in the pen, as a fraction between 0 and 1

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Date and time at which the measurements in the item were taken

luminosity.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. The brightness of a light source at the item. Units:'lux' (UN/CEFACT LUX)

numAnimals.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Number of animals contained in the pen

sex.description: VocabProperty. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. The sex of the animals contained in the pen, held as a controlled-vocabulary term. Enum:'M, F, unknown'

temperature.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Temperature of the pen. Units:'degrees Celsius' (UN/CEFACT CEL)

waterConsumption.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. The total amount of water that came out from the tap(s) in the pen

weightStDev.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. The standard deviation associated with the average weight of the animals contained in the pen. Units:'kilograms' (UN/CEFACT KGM)
